title: Theo and the Kitchen
author: Ansel Yarrow
blurb: Marguerite Voss, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
